epic.title: Deliver the SAUCARA WhatsApp-first pastry website
epic.objective: Create an owner-review-ready French one-page experience that presents premium custom pastry work and prepares qualified WhatsApp enquiries.

tasks.title: Install and validate Agency OS
tasks.objective: Establish the governed owner-release workflow in the target repository without overwriting the initial project.
acceptance_criteria: Official installer dry-run is reviewed before apply
All installed skills and agents validate
Setup is isolated in its own commit

tasks.title: Define product and conversion strategy
tasks.objective: Turn the brief into a truthful WhatsApp-first proposition, CTA hierarchy, objection plan, and measurable outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Primary audiences, job, funnel, CTA language, form friction, and demo boundaries are explicit
No unsupported proof or confirmation claim is planned
verification: Read-only product and conversion specialist review against the owner brief

tasks.title: Specify UX and French content architecture
tasks.objective: Define the one-page hierarchy, user journeys, complete French content, responsive behavior, and interaction states.
acceptance_criteria: All required sections and FAQ topics map to a coherent information hierarchy
Menu, FAQ, form, keyboard, focus, and reduced-motion states are testable
verification: Content invariant tests and browser journey review

tasks.title: Establish visual system and licensed assets
tasks.objective: Create a distinctive accessible Casablanca editorial direction and a documented local photography set.
acceptance_criteria: Green/cream/gold tokens, typography, editorial grid, and Cadre Casablanca device are documented
Every external asset is local, optimized, sourced, and visibly treated as demo imagery

tasks.title: Scaffold the static-first Next.js application
tasks.objective: Provide a strict, maintainable App Router foundation with quality tooling and minimal runtime dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Current compatible versions are verified and locked
Server/client boundaries, metadata, 404, tests, formatting, lint, typecheck, build, and E2E scripts are configured

tasks.title: Implement the responsive one-page experience
tasks.objective: Build every required section, local-image composition, navigation, metadata, and branded 404 in natural French.
acceptance_criteria: All owner-required sections and content are present
Layouts work from 320px through wide desktop with semantic HTML, visible focus, reduced motion, and no overflow
All links and local images resolve
verification: Playwright responsive screenshots and navigation tests

tasks.title: Implement WhatsApp, form, menu, and test coverage
tasks.objective: Make the conversion interactions robust, accessible, privacy-preserving, and independently reproducible.
acceptance_criteria: Form exposes invalid, prepared, and recoverable failure states without storage or submission
Mobile menu and FAQ work by keyboard
WhatsApp URL encoding and demo fallback are tested
Critical journey E2E tests include axe, console, overflow, links, images, and reduced motion

tasks.title: Run independent quality board and owner handoff
tasks.objective: Verify the stable candidate, correct bounded defects, and provide one evidence-based owner delivery packet.
acceptance_criteria: Formatting, lint, typecheck, tests, build, browser QA, accessibility, performance, and independent review pass or have explicit bounded exceptions
Desktop/mobile screenshots and exact local run steps are recorded
No deploy, push, PR, merge, or release occurs
